analysis.scope: 用 Python + pygame 实现单屏 8×8 固定迷宫寻出口小游戏。地图用二维列表存墙/路/出口；方向键每次按下移动一格，不可穿墙或越界；到达出口显示胜利与本轮耗时；R 键重置玩家位置与计时；Esc 或关窗退出；开始前与胜利后都要持续处理按键和关窗；限帧，耗时按真实时间。不做自动生成迷宫、寻路提示、敌人、联网或排行。
analysis.technical_plan: 语言 Python，图形库 pygame（按上下文假定，可改）。核心结构：二维列表常量地图；玩家用 (col,row) 网格坐标；移动前先判断目标格是否合法（在 8×8 内且非墙）。主循环分状态：READY（开始前）、PLAYING、WIN，三态都执行 pygame.event 处理与绘制。移动用 KEYDOWN 事件边沿，不读持续按键状态。计时用 pygame.time.get_ticks() 或 time.monotonic()，按毫秒差值算真实耗时；clock.tick(60) 限帧。到达出口切 WIN 并记录结束时间；R 键在 READY/WIN 重置玩家与起点时间。循环不因胜利而终止，仅在 QUIT/Esc 时退出。
assumptions: 图形库选用 pygame，基于项目上下文，属于可修改假设。
地图为固定 8×8，玩家起点与出口位置在代码中写定。
网格坐标为 (列, 行)，左上角为 (0,0)，墙用 1、路用 0、出口用 2 表示（表示方式可改）。
耗时单位用秒并保留一位小数；显示为近似值也接受。
开始前按方向键不移动，仅 R/Esc 生效。

Score
For simplicity we are simply going to be increasing the score each time a bullet hits our goblin/enemy.
We are going to start by creating a variable at the top of our program called score.
score = 0
Next we are going to increment the score from our main loop where we check if the goblin is hit.

font = pygame.font.SysFont("comicsans", 30, True) # The first argument is the font, next is size # and then True to make our font bold
After we create our font we need to render some text and blit it to the screen.
# This should go inside the redrawGameWindow function text = font.render("Score: " + str(score), 1, (0,0,0)) # Arguments are: text, anti-aliasing, color win.blit(text, (390, 10))
Health Bar
What we are going to do now is give our enemy health and a health bar. This way we can see when we should remove it from the screen. To create the health bar we are going to draw two rectangles. One green and one red. We will change the width of the green rectangle (which will overlay the red one) each time the enemy is hit.
To do this we must modify the enemy class like so.
Now we have a health bar that will move down as our goblin is hit.

resource.description:
Tutorial #1
In this tutorial series we will be working to create the famous snake game in python with the module pygame. If you are more interested in a general pygame tutorial series click here
Starter Code
To make our lives a bit easier I've set up the main structure for our game already. We are going to be using two main classes (snake and cube).
Creating our Game Loop
In all games we have a loop called a "main loop" or "game loop". This loop will continuously run until the game is exited. It is mainly responsible for checking for events and calling functions and methods based on those events.
We are going to be coding our game loop inside the main() function. We will declare some variables at the top of the function then move into our while loop which will represent our game loop.
```python
def main(): 
    global width, rows, s
    width = 500  # Width of our screen
    height = 500  # Height of our screen
    rows = 20  # Amount of rows

    win = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))  # Creates our screen object

    s = snake((255,0,0), (10,10))  # Creates a snake object which we will code later

    clock = pygame.time.Clock() # creating a clock object

    flag = True
    # STARTING MAIN LOOP
    while flag:
        pygame.time.delay(50)  # This will delay the game so it doesn't run too quickly
        clock.tick(10)  # Will ensure our game runs at 10 FPS
        redrawWindow(win)  # This will refresh our screen

functions.name: 8×8 二维列表地图与绘制
functions.original_requirement: 地图用二维列表表示墙、路和出口
functions.acceptance_criteria: 屏幕按 8×8 绘制出固定迷宫，墙/路/出口三格区分可见，地图数据来自一个二维列表。

functions.name: 方向键单格移动与穿墙/越界阻挡
functions.original_requirement: 方向键每次按下移动一格，不能穿墙或越出地图
functions.acceptance_criteria: 每次按键沿对应方向只移动一格；目标是墙或超出 0..7 范围时位置不变。

functions.name: 到达出口显示胜利与本轮耗时
functions.original_requirement: 到达出口后显示胜利和本轮耗时
functions.acceptance_criteria: 玩家进入出口格时画面显示胜利文字与本轮秒数。

functions.name: R 键重置玩家位置与计时
functions.original_requirement: 按R可重置玩家位置与计时
functions.acceptance_criteria: 按 R 后玩家回到起点、计时归零并重新开始计时，游戏回到可玩状态。

functions.name: Esc/关窗退出与开始前后持续响应
functions.original_requirement: Esc或关闭窗口可退出。开始前和胜利后都必须能处理按键与关窗
functions.acceptance_criteria: 在开始前、游戏中、胜利后按 Esc 或关闭窗口都能退出；胜利后仍能按 R 重置。

functions.name: 限帧与真实时间计时
functions.original_requirement: 使用帧率上限，耗时依据真实时间而非帧数
functions.acceptance_criteria: 主循环 tick 限帧；耗时由真实时钟差值计算，帧率变化不影响显示秒数。
